test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ADVISORY' is written as 'BFYMRMOU', and 'CHAMPION' is written as 'DJDQOGLJ'. How will 'DESIGNER' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'ADVISORY' is written as 'BFYMRMOU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c0e725059e31e7270bc4222ab0020cbd5f8d80b1d901cd13a7b4e5eef2658fc.png] 

'CHAMPION' is written as 'DJDQOGLJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a0815976cea811f69c540f080c678fe48a716ace2654452c63952b5c4788bb1.png] 

Similarly, 'DESIGNER' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c706d1c11b7b655ac0cfa1dfbdeac848190e840e9b88cd7b74e78808a9a45cb.png] 

Hence, **'EGVMFLBN'** is the correct answer.
